description: Where the tax adviser or the team ask for things, like a receipt that is missing or a purchase nobody described. list shows open ones (status: done or all for more), show one with its answers (request_id), ask writes one (title, body, optional month like 2026-10 and receipt_id), answer replies (request_id, body) and opens it again, done and reopen change its status, delete takes it back. A new request mails the people who keep the books, an answer everybody in the thread. Whoever reads the receipts may use it.

action.description: list (default), show, ask, answer, done, reopen or delete

month.description: ask, optional: the month it is about, YYYY-MM

proof.description: An EIP-4361 message you got from a challenge, signed by your wallet

receipt_id.description: ask, optional: the receipt it is about, from receipts.list

request_id.description: show, answer, done, reopen and delete: the request, from list

session_token.description: A lounge session token (lg_...) if you have one

name: company.requests
title: The board: requests between people and agents
